title: The Room Behind the Wall
description: A terrifying late-night discovery reveals a room that should never have existed.

scenes.narration: At three seventeen in the morning, someone knocked from inside my bedroom wall.
scenes.visual: A frightened young man alone in a small old apartment bedroom at night, staring toward a cracked bedroom wall, cinematic photorealistic horror film, cold blue lighting
scenes.motion: Slow cinematic camera push toward the man. He slowly turns his head toward the wall. A faint shadow moves behind him.

scenes.narration: I thought it was the neighbours, until the knocking came from directly behind my bed.
scenes.visual: Old apartment bedroom, wooden bed pushed against a damaged plaster wall, frightened man sitting on bed, realistic cinematic horror
scenes.motion: The camera moves slowly from the man's face toward the wall. Three small vibrations shake the picture frame.

scenes.narration: Then a voice whispered my name, from the other side.
scenes.visual: Close view of a cracked bedroom wall, dark narrow crack in plaster, terrified man listening, realistic horror cinematography
scenes.motion: The crack slowly spreads across the plaster. The camera creeps closer as dust falls.

scenes.narration: I pulled the wardrobe away and found a small wooden door.
scenes.visual: A heavy wardrobe moved aside revealing a tiny old wooden door hidden inside the bedroom wall, dark apartment, cinematic horror
scenes.motion: The wardrobe slowly scrapes across the floor. The camera reveals the hidden door behind it.

scenes.narration: Behind it was another bedroom, and someone was sleeping in my bed.
scenes.visual: Impossible second bedroom behind a hidden door, identical bed, shadowy human figure lying beneath a blanket, unsettling photorealism
scenes.motion: The camera slowly moves through the doorway. The covered figure begins to sit up.

scenes.narration: Then I heard my own voice behind me say, you were not supposed to open that door.
scenes.visual: Terrifying dark bedroom doorway, a pale shadowy double of the man standing behind him, dramatic low-key lighting, cinematic horror
scenes.motion: The camera slowly turns toward the second figure. The figure takes one slow step forward as the lights flicker.
